title: SEED-L01 post-waiver read-back summary total outstanding (derive-don't-store)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the SEED-L01 loan-detail summary read-back taken AFTER the 1000.00 interest waiver (MANIFEST objects.waiver: loan 1, transaction 13, amount 1000.00). request.summary.principal_outstanding_minor=10000000 is the capture summary's "principalOutstanding":100000.000000 in minor units; request.summary.interest_outstanding_minor=561853 is "interestOutstanding":5618.530000, the pre-waiver 6618.53 reduced by the "interestWaived":1000.000000 that the same summary block reports; the fee and penalty buckets are empty. expect.summary_total_minor=10561853 is "totalOutstanding":105618.530000 in minor units, the total Fineract derived from the post-waiver buckets. This pins a DIFFERENT (principal, interest, total) observation from the pre-waiver loan-1-detail-raw.json read-back (106618.53), so the derive-don't-store total is asserted over two independent loan-1 observations; and it discriminates: the registered wrong implementation loan-wrong-summary-interest-not-outstanding (principal + fee only, interest bucket treated as recovered) reads 10000000 here, 561853 short of the posted total. Nothing was computed by this promotion; the loan slice has no interest-waiver arithmetic, and this vector grades only the derived total of the read-back buckets.

provenance.note: request.summary buckets and expect.summary_total_minor are transcribed from the "summary" block of the committed capture loan-1-detail-after-raw.json; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan.
